onboarding.title: Welcome to TabRunner
onboarding.tagline: An AI agent that uses your browser tabs, sessions and logins to get tasks done.
onboarding.connectPrompt: To start, connect a provider. Sign in with a subscription you already pay for, or paste an API key. Your credentials stay on this device and go straight to the provider. There is no TabRunner server.
onboarding.presetsNote: {{count}} presets, including Claude, ChatGPT, Kimi, Z.ai and Ollama, or any compatible endpoint.

settings.defaultStartUrlHint: A task starts on the page you're looking at. If Chrome blocks it, as it does with chrome:// and the Web Store, the task opens here instead.
settings.showWidgetHint: A small floating indicator on your tabs while a task runs or waits in line.
settings.showTipsHint: Occasional shortcuts and feature tips under the composer, and while a task runs.
settings.invalidUrl: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://
settings.aboutBody: TabRunner is an open-source browser agent. Describe a task and it uses your browser through the AI provider you choose. The code is on GitHub under the MIT license. You can report bugs, suggest ideas or send pull requests.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.help: Let external AI clients use this agent through the local bridge. You can also connect to remote MCP servers and use their tools in every run.
mcp.enableHint: The extension connects to a local daemon started by your AI client. When disabled, it opens no port and wakes nothing up.
mcp.portHint: Must match the daemon's TABRUNNER_BRIDGE_PORT. Default is 17836.
mcp.invalidPort: Enter a whole number between 1024 and 65535
mcp.guideTitle: How MCP works in both directions
mcp.guideIn: Clients dial in (the bridge): an external AI client spawns a small local daemon, TabRunner connects out to it, and that client's tasks run in this browser with your logged-in sessions. Off costs nothing.
mcp.guideOut: Add an https:// MCP server below to use its tools in every run. Tool names follow mcp__server__tool, and every tool requires plan approval. Auth headers stay local and are never logged.
mcp.guideQuestions: Servers can ask questions during a task. They appear as a card in the panel and are declined automatically on unattended runs. Run events can also be sent as webhooks. See Settings → Behavior.
mcp.statusWaiting: Waiting for the daemon. It starts with your MCP client. If nothing connects, check the port above and run the setup below again.
mcp.setupHelp: Fetch the daemon, then register it with your MCP client:
mcp.extensionIdHint: Set the daemon's TABRUNNER_BRIDGE_EXPECTED_EXTENSION_ID to this.

settings.walkthroughsHint: Let the agent turn a task into a shareable step-by-step walkthrough when you ask it to. Screenshots stay on this computer and are never sent to the model.

jev.title: Jev for routine steps
jev.help: Jev is a low-cost model that picks what to click. With it on, your main model can hand it simple runs of clicking and typing, then check the result. Before a click that looks like paying, sending or deleting, Jev stops and hands back.
jev.menuHint: Low-cost clicks and typing for simple steps
jev.setupHint: No key saved. Add one under Providers to turn it on.
jev.accountIdHint: It's on your account's home page in the Cloudflare dashboard.
jev.removeBody: Runs go back to using only your main model. You can add a key again any time.

privacy.typesafe: Jev sees the controls and text on the tab it works in, the goal, and the values it may type. TypeSafe doesn't train on it and keeps it only as long as it needs to.
privacy.openrouter: Jev sees the controls and text on the tab it works in, the goal, and the values it may type. It goes through OpenRouter to TypeSafe, which doesn't train on it.
privacy.cloudflare: Jev sees the controls and text on the tab it works in, the goal, and the values it may type. Cloudflare runs Jev itself and keeps none of it.
privacy.vercel: Jev sees the controls and text on the tab it works in, the goal, and the values it may type. It goes through Vercel to TypeSafe, which doesn't train on it.

error.missingAccount: Cloudflare also needs your account ID.
error.auth: {{host}} didn't accept this key. Check that you copied all of it, or make a new one.
error.authCloudflare: Cloudflare didn't accept this token or account ID. Check both, and that the token can use Workers AI.
error.quota: Your {{host}} account is out of credit. Add some, then try again.
error.busy: {{host}} is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
error.network: TabRunner couldn't reach {{host}}. Check your connection, then try again.
error.other: {{host}} returned an error: {{detail}}. Try again, or pick another host.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.help: Things TabRunner should always or never do in every chat. Write plain sentences. Start a line with "## site: acme.com" to apply everything under it only on that site.
instructions.placeholder:
Always ask me before sending an email or making a payment.
My work email is me@acme.com.

## site: github.com
Always work in the acme-corp organization.
instructions.autosave: Saved as you type. Takes effect on your next task.

memory.title: What TabRunner remembers
memory.help: Facts TabRunner has picked up from your tasks, so it doesn't have to ask twice. Facts tied to one site load only when a task starts there. Delete anything that's wrong.
memory.empty: No memories yet. As tasks run, TabRunner saves what is worth remembering about you or the sites you use. You do not need to add it by hand.
memory.off: Memory is off. TabRunner is not saving what it learns. Turn it on above to resume.

skills.title: Skills
skills.help: Skills are saved instructions for doing a task your way. TabRunner offers them to the model when a task matches. Site-specific skills are offered only when a task starts on that site.
skills.empty: No skills yet. A skill records how to do a task: the steps, the site and what to watch out for. Save one from a chat with /skill new, write one with New skill, or use Import to bring in one written by someone else.
skills.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard. Try again in a moment.
skills.deleteDescription: Future tasks won't see it anymore. This can't be undone.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. This is the name /skill and the model use.
form.descriptionHint: Explain what it does and when to use it. The model uses this to decide whether to load it.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Downloads the newest invoice PDF from the vendor's billing page
form.sitesHint: Comma-separated domains, like acme.com. On those sites it's offered automatically; empty offers it everywhere.
form.bodyPlaceholder: The steps in order, including pages, buttons, fields and things to watch out for.

import.title: Import a skill
import.description: Fetch a SKILL.md from a URL or GitHub shorthand, or paste one. Nothing saves until you review it.
import.urlHint: A raw .md URL, a GitHub file page, or owner/repo shorthand.
import.review: Review before saving. On matching tasks, the model receives these instructions as if you wrote them.
import.ignored: Fields TabRunner skills don't use were skipped: {{list}}
import.droppedSites: Site entries that aren't domains were skipped: {{list}}
import.errorHttp: Only https URLs can be imported. An http source could be changed in transit. Find an https link and try again.
import.errorUnparseable: That doesn't look like an https URL or an owner/repo shorthand. Check it and try again.
import.errorTimeout: The server did not answer within 10 seconds. It may be slow or down. Try again in a moment.
import.errorNetwork: The download failed. The address may be wrong or the server unreachable. Check the URL and try again.
import.errorStatus: The server answered {{status}}. The file may have moved or be private. Check the URL and try again.
import.errorTooLarge: That file is over 256 KB, too large for a skill. Use a link to the SKILL.md itself, not an archive.
import.errorEmpty: The server answered with an empty file. Check that the URL points to the SKILL.md.
import.errorNothingPasted: Paste the skill's markdown first, including the settings at the top and the instructions.
import.errorNoUrl: Enter a location first: a raw .md URL, a GitHub file page, or owner/repo.
import.multiReview: This repo has more than one skill. Uncheck anything you do not want. Each import is fully validated.
import.truncated: The repo is too large to list in full. There may be more skills than shown.
import.rowSkippedExists: Already saved with this name. Nothing changed. Import it separately to replace it.
import.rowSkippedCap: Not imported. The limit of 50 skills has been reached.
import.mcpConsent: Check the servers you want to install. They will be enabled in Settings → MCP.
import.mcpCredentialWarning: Headers pasted into skill files are credentials. Install only servers you trust.
import.mcpRowFailed: Could not add this server. Add it by hand in Settings → MCP.
import.mcpDoneHint: Servers stay in Settings → MCP whether you import them or add them yourself. Edit or remove them there.

draft.title: New skill from this chat
draft.description: TabRunner turns what this chat worked out into instructions you can use again. Review and edit them before saving.
draft.errorNothing: This chat has no task to turn into a skill yet. Run a task first, then save what you learned.
draft.errorTimeout: The model did not answer within 90 seconds. It may be overloaded. Try again.
draft.errorEmpty: The model answered with nothing to save. Try again, or write the skill by hand.

errors.badName: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, like "invoice-download". The name "new" is reserved.
errors.noDescription: Add a description. Without it, the model cannot see the skill.
errors.noBody: Add instructions. An empty skill cannot tell the model what to do.
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description is over {{max}} characters. Shorten it to a brief summary and put the steps in the instructions.
errors.bodyTooLong: The instructions are over {{max}} characters. Shorten the steps or split them into two skills.
errors.reservedName: A built-in slash command already uses that name. Pick another.
errors.nameTaken: A skill named "{{name}}" already exists. Pick another name or edit that skill.
errors.tooMany: You have reached the limit of {{max}} skills. Delete one you no longer use before adding another.

skills.manageHelp: Enable, edit or import saved skills. Each one also has its own slash command.

errors.tooMany: The limit is {{max}} MCP servers. Remove one before adding another.
errors.invalidUrl: Enter an https:// URL (plain http:// works for localhost only).
errors.invalidName: Give the server a name of up to 32 characters.
errors.duplicate: A server with this name already exists.

run.serverDown: MCP server "{{name}}" is unreachable. Continuing without its tools.

mcpOut.title: Connect to MCP servers
mcpOut.help: Add remote MCP servers whose tools this agent can call during its runs. Every remote tool sits behind plan approval, like page actions.
mcpOut.dialogHelp: The agent lists this server's tools when a run starts and may call them once a plan is approved.
mcpOut.nameHint: Keep it short: letters, digits and hyphens. It becomes part of tool names.
mcpOut.urlHint: https:// anywhere; plain http:// only for localhost.
mcpOut.headersHint: Sent verbatim with every request. Values stay in this browser's storage and are never logged.
mcpOut.deleteDescription: Its tools leave new runs. Anything already in a transcript stays.
mcpOut.empty: No remote MCP servers yet. Add one to give TabRunner tools it can use in every run. Every tool requires your plan approval before it can run.

errors.tooMany: The limit is {{max}} webhooks. Remove one before adding another.
errors.invalidUrl: Enter an https:// URL (plain http:// works for localhost only).
errors.badEvent: Pick one of the four events.

hooks.title: Webhooks
hooks.help: Send a JSON payload with POST to your URL when a run starts, finishes, fails or asks you a question. The run does not wait for a reply, so a slow endpoint cannot delay it.
hooks.dialogHelp: One event to one URL. The payload is the event's details as JSON; deliveries are single-shot, no retries.
hooks.urlHint: https:// anywhere; plain http:// only for localhost.
hooks.headersHint: For now, add auth headers by editing the rule in storage. Plain webhooks do not need them.
hooks.deleteDescription: Future events stop being delivered. Nothing already sent is affected.
hooks.empty: No webhooks yet. Add one to notify your URL when a run starts, finishes, fails or asks you a question.

schedule.lateNote: This run was scheduled for {{scheduled}} and is starting late, because the browser was closed until now. Take the delay into account, and say so in your summary if it changes the answer.
schedule.historyLostNote: The earlier conversation for this schedule is no longer stored, so there is no record of what its previous runs found. Treat this as a first run. Do not assume any work was already done.

errors.pastFire: That time has already passed. Pick a future time.
errors.badDays: days must be numbers from 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday).
errors.badTime: "{{value}}" is not a valid time. Use 24-hour HH:MM, like "09:00".
errors.tooFrequent: A repeating task runs at most every {{min}} minutes.
errors.badWindow: The window's end time has to come after its start.
errors.badRecurrence: recurrence needs a kind of "once", "daily" or "interval", plus the field that kind requires: at, time, or every_minutes.
errors.neverFires: This rule has no future run time. Check the time and days.
errors.tooMany: There are already {{max}} scheduled tasks, the most TabRunner keeps. Cancel one before adding another.
errors.selfOnly: A scheduled run can only re-time the schedule it is running from, never create a new one. If new work should be scheduled, ask the user.
errors.chainExhausted: This schedule has rescheduled itself {{max}} times without the user stepping in. Stop here and report what you found.
errors.noTask: task is required. Say what the scheduled run should do.
errors.noId: id is required. Use one from the scheduled-tasks list.
errors.notFound: No schedule with id {{id}}. It may already be cancelled. Check the scheduled-tasks list.

ui.title: Scheduled tasks
ui.help: Work TabRunner runs on its own, in a tab of its own. Each one keeps its own chat, and notifies you when it finishes.
ui.emptyBody: Scheduled tasks run without supervision, such as a morning inbox summary or an hourly price check.
ui.emptyAction: Ask for one in the side panel: “every weekday at 9am, summarize my inbox”. Approve the plan and it appears here.
ui.runNowOnce: Run now as a test. It will still run at the scheduled time.
ui.queued: Queued. Starts when the current task finishes.
ui.pause: Pause (keep the task and chat; stop the timer)
ui.resume: Resume (recalculate the next run from now)
ui.deleteRunning: Delete this schedule and stop the task in progress
ui.deleteBody: The rule is removed and nothing else fires. Its chat stays in your history.
ui.deleteBodyRunning: This task is running. Deleting it stops the current run. Its chat stays in your history.

step.evaluate: Run a script on the page

doc.prerequisite: Before you start: sign in to {{hosts}} with an account that can do this.
doc.notePartial: This task was interrupted, so the walkthrough stops before the process finished.
doc.noteTruncated: The process was too long to fit in one document. Later steps are not shown.
doc.noteLateArm_one: Documenting started after the first action, which is not shown.
doc.noteLateArm_other: Documenting started after the first {{count}} actions, which are not shown.
doc.noteDegraded: Some screens could not be captured on this browser, so a few steps have no picture.
doc.noteStopped: The task was stopped by hand before it finished.
doc.noteFailed: The task ended on an error, so the last step may not have worked.

card.title: Walkthrough
card.review: Check the screenshots before sharing. They show whatever was on screen.

viewer.missingBody: The screenshots were deleted. A walkthrough is removed when its chat is deleted or storage fills up.
viewer.missingFix: Run the task again and ask TabRunner to document it.
viewer.emptyBody: The task was documented, but no screenshot could be captured. The tab was probably closed or blocked before the first shot. Run it again to make a new recording.

addProvider.title: Add provider
addProvider.description: Sign in or paste an API key. Your saved sign-in or key stays on this device and is sent only to the provider.

providerForm.groupSubscription: Subscription (a plan you already pay for)
providerForm.groupApiKey: API key (paste a key; pay per use)
providerForm.name: Name
providerForm.apiKeyPlaceholderSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
providerForm.nameRequired: Give it a name you will recognize.
providerForm.baseUrlRequired: A custom endpoint needs a base URL.
providerForm.baseUrlInvalid: The base URL is not valid. Include https:// and any path, like https://api.example.com/v1.
providerForm.apiKeyRequired: Paste an API key above. Local endpoints like Ollama don't need one.
providerForm.keyHintKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved key.
providerForm.keyRejected: {{name}} didn't accept this key. Check you copied the whole key and that it belongs to this provider, then try again.
providerForm.modelNote: Pick the model and reasoning effort for each task in the side panel. The newest model is the default.
providerForm.signInHint: Uses your {{provider}} subscription. No API key needed.
providerForm.signInMintsKey: Creates an API key on your {{provider}} account. No copying or pasting needed.
providerForm.signInOpened: We opened {{host}} in a new tab. Approve the sign-in there to finish.
providerForm.signInBlocked: If the tab didn't open, use this link:
providerForm.signInExpiredBody: Sign-in links and codes are only valid for a few minutes. Start over to get a fresh one.
providerForm.signInDeniedBody: The request was rejected on the approval page. Start over and approve it to connect {{provider}}.

providerList.emptyBody: A provider supplies the AI model that uses your browser. Pick a preset or enter the URL of an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API.
providerList.removeActiveBody: This is your active provider. The next one in the list becomes active. TabRunner deletes the API key or sign-in it stored for this provider.
providerList.removeBody: TabRunner deletes the API key or sign-in it stored for this provider. You can add it again at any time.
providerList.signOutBody: TabRunner deletes this saved sign-in and stops using the subscription. The provider stays in your list. You can sign in again whenever you like.

modelPicker.modelTitle: Model for the next task. Auto picks the newest when the run starts.
modelPicker.modelTitleFor: {{model}}: model for the next task. Auto picks the newest when the run starts.
modelPicker.noModelListHint: The endpoint did not return a model list. Enter a model id or leave empty to pick automatically when the run starts.
modelPicker.effortHint: Reasoning effort for the next task. If the provider does not support the level you pick, its error appears in chat.

enginePicker.triggerTitle: {{label}}: provider, model and effort for the next task
enginePicker.noMatch: No model matches “{{query}}”. Clear the filter to see the full list.
enginePicker.moreModels: {{n}} more. Narrow the filter to see them.
enginePicker.listFallback: The current model list did not load. Showing the saved list, which may be out of date. Reopen this picker to try again.
enginePicker.thisChatOnly: Hold {{mod}} to change only this chat

usage.title: Subscription usage
usage.empty: The provider did not report usage this time. Try Refresh.

sidepanel.busyRunning: Stop the task before switching chats
sidepanel.close: Close the panel (a running task keeps going)

history.title: History
history.ranOnSchedule: Ran on a schedule, not started by you
history.deleteBody: The transcript is deleted from this device and cannot be recovered. Anything TabRunner learned from it stays in its memory. You can clear that in Settings.
history.deleteScheduledBody: This is a scheduled task's own chat ({{recurrence}}), and its transcript is what each run reads back. Deleting it cancels the schedule too. To stop it for a while instead, pause it in Settings.
history.emptyBody: Every task you send is kept here. Open one to reread what happened, or delete the ones you no longer need.
history.storedNote: Stored on this device · the 50 most recent are kept
history.spentTip: Estimated spend on this conversation, at the model's list prices

chat.stopTitleQueued: Stop (Esc). Queued messages run as the next task.
chat.emptyBody: Describe a task. I can navigate, read pages, click and type on the page you are viewing, using your existing logins. If there is no page to work on, I open my own tab.
chat.emptyExample: Example: "pull the latest invoice from my inbox into the expense report"
chat.portLost: Lost the connection to the agent, so the task stopped. Send it again to pick up.
chat.reloaded: TabRunner was reloaded. Close and reopen this panel to keep going.
chat.runStopped: You stopped this task. Your next message can continue from here.

hint.badKey: The API key is likely missing or invalid. Update it and try again.
hint.signedOut: The sign-in for this provider is no longer valid. Sign in again and retry.
hint.quota: You have used up your plan's quota. Top up with the provider or switch to another one and try again.
hint.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then send again.
hint.rejected: The provider rejected the request. It may not support the model or reasoning effort level. The detail above says which.
hint.network: Could not reach the provider. Check the base URL and your connection, then try again.
hint.noProvider: Pick or add a provider, then try again.

chat.screenshotAlt: Screenshot of the page the agent captured
chat.attachFailed: Could not read that image. The format may not be supported. Copy it again as PNG or JPEG and paste once more.
chat.queueTitle: Inserted between the next tool calls
chat.queuedSteerTitle: Queued for the running task. Arrives between the next tool calls. ↑ to edit.
chat.queueNoImages: Images cannot be added to a running task. Queue the text now and paste the image with the next task.
chat.pasteHint: Long pasted text appears as a note to keep the text field tidy. The full text is still sent. Backspace deletes it.
chat.restrictedPageHint: Chrome blocks extensions on this page. Your task will run in its own tab.
chat.askUserHint: Pick one, or write your own
chat.planPlaceholder: Approve the plan above, or type what should change…
chat.planSendTitle: Send the plan back with your note
chat.planNoImages: Images cannot be attached to a plan note. Type what should change and paste the image once the task is running.
chat.reasoningToggle: Show or hide the model's reasoning (saved for all chats)
chat.emptyExampleDoc: Add “and document it” to any task and you get a guide you can share.

commands.unknown: No command /{{name}}. Type / to see the list.
commands.nextTask: Applies to the next task, not the one running.
commands.thisChatOnly: This chat only. New chats keep the default.

deferred.title: Waiting for the task to finish. Runs as soon as nothing is running here.

stop.none: There is no task running here to stop.
stop.elsewhere: No task is running in this chat. The current task belongs to another chat.
stop.cancelledQueued: Removed your task from the queue. Nothing was started.

background.description: Toggle whether the next task runs in the foreground or in the background
background.invalid: No setting called “{{value}}”. Pick on or off.
background.nowBackground: The next task runs in the background. The panel closes when you approve the plan, and nothing moves your screen after that. The task uses the same tab either way.
background.nowForeground: The next task runs in the foreground. The panel stays open, and tabs the task switches to come to the front.

effort.description: Set reasoning effort: none, low, medium, high, max or default
effort.current: Reasoning effort: {{effort}} ({{provider}}). Use /effort <level> to change it.
effort.unavailable: {{model}} has no reasoning effort setting, so it always runs at its default.

model.description: Set the model for this chat. Use auto to undo it.
model.current: Model: {{model}} ({{provider}}). Use /model <id> to set one, or /model auto for the endpoint's newest.

provider.current: Provider: {{name}}. Also configured: {{others}}. Use /provider <name> to switch.
provider.unknown: No provider "{{value}}". Pick a configured provider: {{list}}.

rename.description: Name this chat. No argument shows the current name.
rename.current: This chat is “{{title}}”. Use /rename <name> to change it.
rename.none: Send a task first. A chat with no messages has nothing to name.

skills.description: Manage saved skills: enable, edit or import them

usage.description: Show the active subscription's usage windows
usage.unsupported: {{provider}} uses an API key. Usage windows are available only with subscription sign-ins (Claude, ChatGPT, Kimi).

mcp.none: No remote MCP servers yet. Add one under Settings → MCP and its tools join every run.

document.description: Run a task and get a shareable step-by-step walkthrough
document.task:
{{task}}

Document this process as a step-by-step walkthrough I can share.
document.hint: Type the task after /document, or add “and document it” to any task.

skill.description: Run a saved skill. /skill new creates one from this chat.
skill.none: No skills yet. Use /skill new to create one from this chat, or import one in Settings → Skills.
skill.emptyConversation: There is nothing here to turn into a skill yet. Run a task first.
skill.taskWithArgs: Use the "{{name}}" skill for this task: {{args}}

compact.description: Summarize this chat so far, to free up context
compact.nothing: There is nothing to summarize yet. This chat is still short enough to send in full.
compact.busy: A task is running. Summarize the chat once it finishes.
compact.failed: Could not summarize the chat: {{message}}. Try again.

keys.recall: Walk back through what you've sent
keys.plan: Expand or collapse every plan card
keys.open: Open help and shortcuts (the text field must be empty)

report.title: Report an issue
report.description: GitHub gets this text when you press Open GitHub. It becomes a public issue only if you submit it there.
report.titlePlaceholder: What went wrong, in a few words
report.detailsHint: Your version, browser, provider and the error. We hide what looks like a key, an email or a path to your files, but read it before you send.

compact.folded: Folded {{count}} earlier turns into a summary to free up context
compact.explain: The messages above stay here for you. The agent receives this summary instead.

context.tooltip: Context: this conversation uses {{used}} of the model's {{window}} input limit. Use /compact to summarize the chat and free up space.
context.tooltipUnknown: Context: this conversation uses {{used}}. The model's input limit is unknown, so no percentage can be shown. Use /compact to summarize the chat and free up space.

plan.title: Plan
plan.peekToggle: Show or hide the whole plan
plan.reapprovalTitle: The plan changed. Approve the new one?
plan.revisionNote: The user requested changes to this plan. Call `plan` again with a revised list. It returns to the user for approval. No page action runs before that.
plan.narrowedNote: This list removed steps the run already finished, so they disappeared from the progress card. Call `plan` again with the full list, including finished steps and the cursor past them, unless the user cancelled those steps.
plan.shrunkNote: This run's first plan has fewer steps than the {{count}}-step plan this conversation already approved. Standing approval accepted it without a card, so the user did not see the shorter plan. Call `plan` again with the full approved list and the cursor at the current step, unless the user cancelled those steps or replaced the task in their new message.

run.newSkills: New skills are available on this site. Before acting here, use the skill tool to load any that match the task:
run.drivingTabTip: Go to this page (reopens it if the tab is gone)
run.bridgeTask: {{client}} is running a task in your browser
run.bridgeStopTitle: Stops the task and hands the browser back
run.backgroundNowTitle: Close the panel and let this task finish on its own. It will not move your screen. Reopen the panel any time to watch.
run.backgroundNowGated: Answer the waiting plan or question first. Closing now would leave the task waiting for a reply through a notification.
run.modeTitle: “In foreground” keeps the panel open and brings the task's selected tab to the front. “In background” closes the panel when you approve the plan and never moves your screen. Both use your current tab. Switching during a task applies at once, once the plan is approved.
run.tabReopenedNote: The tab you were working on was closed, so TabRunner reopened {{url}} in a new tab. The old page lost its unsaved input, scroll position and any work in progress. Check what actually completed before repeating a step.

queue.queuedTitle: Waiting for the current task to finish

widget.openHint: Watch the run (opens the panel beside the page TabRunner is using)
widget.hideHint: Collapse to a small dot. Click the dot to show the widget again.
widget.settledHint: Open TabRunner to see the result

tips.label: Tip
tips.escStop: Esc stops the task. Text you already typed is sent as the next task.
tips.historyRecall: ↑ shows messages you sent. ↓ goes forward and brings back your draft.
tips.foreground: Tasks use your current tab. “In background” just closes the panel.
tips.queueSteer: Keep typing while a task runs. Your message reaches it between steps.
tips.pasteImage: Paste a screenshot into the text field so the agent can see it.
tips.pasteCollapse: Your first long paste appears as a note. The agent still gets the full text.
tips.planApproval: A task shows its plan before page actions. Approve it or request changes.
tips.planExpand: Press E to expand/collapse the plan.
tips.widget: Click any TabRunner mark on a page to bring the panel back.
tips.board: Another chat's task appears under Tasks at the top. Open its tab or stop it there.
tips.memory: Review or delete facts TabRunner learned in Settings → Memory.
tips.usage: With a subscription, see 5-hour and weekly use at the bottom of the model picker.
tips.slashCommands: Type / for commands to change provider, model or effort during a chat.
tips.compact: /compact sends a summary instead of older messages. Your chat history stays.
tips.schedule: Ask “every weekday at 9am, check my inbox”. Manage scheduled tasks in Settings.
tips.skills: Taught it something in this chat? /skill new saves the recipe for next time.
tips.siteInstructions: In Instructions, a “## site: acme.com” line scopes everything under it to that site.
tips.enginePicker: Pick provider, model and effort for this chat next to Send. /model also works.
tips.engineScope: Each chat keeps its model and effort. New chats use your last choice.
tips.help: Press ? with an empty text field for shortcuts and commands. /help also works.
tips.walkthrough: Ask “and document it” and the agent writes the process up as a shareable guide.
tips.mcpOut: /mcp shows which remote servers answered. Add more in Settings → MCP.
tips.webhooks: Send run events to your URL with webhooks in Settings → Behavior.
tips.skillsManage: Type /skills to manage skills. Each one also has its own command.
tips.jev: Add a Jev key under Settings → Providers to spend less on simple clicking.

notify.doneFallback: Task finished. Open TabRunner to see how it went.

progress.interrupted: This run was interrupted before it could finish. What it had already done:
progress.stopped: The user stopped this run before it finished. What it had already done:
progress.resume: Call read_history to see these steps' full results, then continue from where it stopped instead of repeating them.
progress.resumeStopped: The user's next message decides what happens to this work. They may continue it or choose another task. Call read_history when you need these steps' full results.

stop.done: Done: the page shows what done_when asked for.
stop.hand_back: Handed back: the next step needs a value it wasn't given, or can't be undone.
stop.irreversible: Stopped before {{detail}}: that step can't be undone, so it needs the user's OK.
stop.no_progress: Stopped: its last 3 actions didn't change the page.
stop.repeat: Stopped: it kept trying {{detail}}, which did nothing.
stop.unstable: Stopped: the page kept changing before it could act.
stop.unsure: Stopped: it wasn't sure what to do next ({{detail}}).
stop.stuck: Stopped: it judged that it was going nowhere.
stop.max_actions: Stopped: it used up its actions.
stop.max_calls: Stopped: it used up its decisions.
stop.new_tab: Stopped: the page opened a new tab. list_tabs shows it.
stop.left_site: Stopped: the page moved to another site ({{detail}}).
stop.restricted: Stopped: the page moved somewhere extensions can't work ({{detail}}).

error.auth: the host rejected the Jev key
error.quota: the Jev account is out of credit
error.network: the Jev host can't be reached

tool.missingGoal: delegate needs both goal and done_when.
tool.unavailable: delegate is off: Jev is switched off or has no key.
tool.failed: Jev couldn't run: {{why}}. Carry on by hand. The user can check the key in Settings → Providers.
tool.verify: Check the snapshot below before you go on. Jev can be wrong about being done.
tool.continue: Carry on by hand from the snapshot below. Don't delegate this same goal again.

errors.alreadyRunningMCP: A task from an external MCP client is already running. Stop it from the client (tabrunner.stop), or wait for it to finish.
errors.alreadyRunningPanel: A task is already running in the TabRunner panel. Open the panel and stop it, or wait for it to finish.
errors.noActiveProvider: No active provider. Pick one in the panel dropdown or add one in Settings, then try again.
errors.noActiveTab: No active tab to work with. Click the tab you want, then send the task again.
errors.runCancelled: That queued task was cancelled before it started
errors.tabCreateFailed: Couldn't open a tab for the task: {{message}}
errors.tabClosed: The tab this task was using ({{title}}) was closed, so the task stopped. TabRunner works on the page itself, never a copy. Retry reopens it and continues from where the run stopped.
errors.providerError: The provider could not do that: {{message}}
errors.outputLimit: The model reached its output limit while answering, so the answer may be incomplete. Ask it to continue or make the question more specific.
errors.textOnlyImages: This model cannot receive images, so your attached images were not sent to it. It works from text descriptions of the page.
errors.taskComplete: Finished, but it didn't say what it found. Ask what happened and it'll read back its own steps.
errors.doneLostSummary: You reached the output limit and the final summary arrived empty. Resume directly, without an apology or recap, and do not call more tools before `done`. The full analysis is already in this conversation as your earlier message. Call `done` and put that answer in the summary. If it is long, split it into smaller pieces so it is not cut off again.
errors.stepBudgetExhausted: The task reached its step limit before finishing. This is a safety limit, not a crash. Send the task again to continue, or ask for a smaller task.
errors.noRunGroup: Could not add that tab to a group. It may have closed, or grouping may not be available in this session. You can still use switch_tab to work there.
errors.tabGroupOtherWindow: That tab is in another window. A tab group cannot span windows. You can still use switch_tab to work there, but the tab stays outside the group.
errors.historyEmpty: The transcript is empty. This chat has not run a task yet.
errors.historyNoMatches: Nothing in the transcript matches “{{query}}”. Try a shorter phrase.
errors.historyUnavailable: This task has no chat attached, so there is no transcript to read.
errors.modelListError: Could not load the model list. The endpoint answered {{status}}. {{detail}}
errors.noModel: No model set for {{name}} and the endpoint doesn't list any. Pick a model in Settings.
errors.noModelData: The endpoint answered, but not with a model list. Type a model id yourself, or leave it empty to auto-pick at run time.
errors.emptyTurns: The model sent no text or tool call for {{count}} turns in a row. The run stopped to avoid using more tokens. Retry or pick another model.
errors.kindEntitlement: {{provider}} accepted the key, but your plan does not include this API. Upgrade the plan on your {{provider}} account
errors.kindQuota: You have used up your quota with {{provider}}. Wait for it to reset or top up your {{provider}} account
errors.kindAuth: {{provider}} rejected the API key. Check it or replace it in the provider settings
errors.kindAuthSignedIn: {{provider}} did not accept the sign-in. Sign in again in the provider settings
errors.dataPolicy: {{provider}} can't run this model until you accept its data policy. It trains on data from your runs. Open {{url}}, accept, then retry
errors.kindModel: {{provider}} does not recognize this model. It may have been renamed or removed. Pick another model
errors.kindRate: {{provider}} is limiting requests. Try again in a moment
errors.kindRateWindow: You reached your {{window}} usage limit with {{provider}}. It resets {{reset}}
errors.kindOverload: {{provider}} is overloaded right now. Try again in a few minutes
errors.kindContext: This chat is longer than {{provider}} can read in one request. Use /compact to summarize it and continue
errors.kindTimeout: {{provider}} stopped responding. Nothing came back in time. Retry, or pick another model if it keeps happening
errors.kindContent: {{provider}}'s safety filter blocked this message. Rewrite it or try another model
errors.kindNetworkOffline: You're offline. The request to {{provider}} never left this machine. Reconnect, then Retry
errors.kindNetworkHost: Couldn't reach {{provider}} at {{host}}. The request never left this machine. Check your connection, any VPN or blocker in the way, and the base URL
errors.kindNetwork: Couldn't reach {{provider}}. The request never left this machine. Check your connection and any VPN or blocker in the way
errors.kindStreamCut: {{provider}} stopped partway through its reply. The connection closed before the answer was done. Retry, or pick another model if it keeps happening
errors.compactEmpty: The model returned an empty summary, so nothing was compacted. Try again, or start a new chat to reset the context.
errors.oauthRefreshExpired: Your {{name}} sign-in expired and could not be renewed. Sign in again in Settings.
errors.signInRateLimited: The provider's sign-in service is refusing requests because there were too many in a short time. This is not about your plan's usage. Wait a minute, then start over.
errors.signInTokenResponse: The sign-in response was incomplete, with no usable token. Start over to try again.
errors.signInDeviceResponse: The sign-in service replied in a format TabRunner didn't recognize. Try again in a moment.
errors.metaSetup: Meta hasn't turned on Muse for this account yet. Finish setup in your Meta account, then sign in again.
errors.metaSetupAt: Meta hasn't turned on Muse for this account yet. Finish setup at {{url}}, then sign in again.
errors.noResponseBody: The provider sent an empty response.
errors.restrictedPage: TabRunner cannot read this page. Chrome blocks extensions on chrome:// and Web Store pages. Open a regular page in this tab and resend the task.
errors.pageNavigating: The page was still loading or navigating. Wait for it to finish and retry.
errors.snapshotFailed: Could not read the page. It may have navigated, or Chrome may block it (chrome://, Web Store). Wait for it to finish loading and try again.
errors.refNotFound: Element ref "{{ref}}" not found. Run snapshot first to get fresh refs.
errors.notAField: That element cannot be filled ({{tag}}). Click buttons, checkboxes and radio buttons instead.
errors.captureEmpty: Nothing has been captured yet. Capture starts when the run attaches to the tab on its first action, screenshot or evaluate call. Trigger what you want to see, then read again.
errors.noTabAttached: Not attached to a tab yet. Attach to one before acting on the page.
errors.noHistoryBack: This tab has no earlier page in its history. Navigate directly to the page you want.
errors.closeDrivenTab: That is the tab you are using. Use switch_tab to switch to another tab before closing it.
errors.findEmpty: find needs something to look for. Pass a word or phrase from the page, or call snapshot to see the whole tree.
errors.pageTextReadPartial: Read {{count}} of {{total}} characters of page text
errors.tabOpenFailed: Couldn't open a new tab. Navigate the current one there instead, or try again.
errors.planEmpty: The plan needs at least one step. Pass a non-empty list of short phrases.
errors.planRejected: Plan rejected. Nothing on the page was changed.
errors.planGateModel: Blocked: no plan is approved yet. Call the plan tool with your intended steps first; the user must approve the plan before any page action runs.
errors.memoryEmpty: There is nothing to remember. Pass the fact as a sentence.
errors.usageUnreadable: The provider's usage reply used a format TabRunner did not recognize. Try Refresh.
errors.documentUnavailable: Documenting is off. Turn on Walkthroughs in Settings, then ask again.
errors.saveSkillNoUrl: No URL given. Provide a direct https URL or owner/repo for the skill.
errors.saveSkillBadUrl: Could not reach a skill file at {{url}}. Use a direct https link to the markdown file or owner/repo[/path].
errors.saveSkillUnnamed: The file has no skill name, and no replacement name was given. Pass a kebab-case name: lowercase words separated by hyphens.
